answer_text: HA Not Ready can be generated when one of the HA pair member sockets is offline, or when the HA status is Not Ready due to Keepalive, or when the HA status is Not Ready due to a Compatible Version issue. The KB points to an XOps Network Playbook for resolving 'Socket HA Status is Not Ready' conditions. The KB does not specify exactly when an 'HA Ready' state is generated after those issues are resolved.
